d: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.
Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.
A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.
When Earth is facing imminent collision with an asteroid, Manuel must survive a last resort automated space program to save the planet in hopes of reuniting with his brother.

Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.
After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.
Grad students invent mind-reading technology that destroys their lives and threatens the future of free will itself.

The summer of 1986. Halley’s comet races around the earth for the first time in 76 years. Three losers in a small town, believing that what they are seeing is your run-of-the-mill shooting star, each make a wish for a better life. But when their wishes are granted too literally, the neighborhood plunges into total chaos.

Researchers reveal the presence of a supreme interdimensional intelligence that has been manipulating mankind for centuries. Interviews with experiencers and alien abductees expose a sinister agenda behind the alien presence on Earth.

There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.
Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the main stage of the Mission Cronos. Orpheus, one of the astronauts who has descended to its surface, is searching for organic life forms. This is his story.
In the year 2050 mankind is extinct. The last survivors travel back in time to stop the invader, the Killgis, in a battle of giant robots.
Two men on the run encounter an old abandoned spaceship in the desert. They escape their pursuers into space and set off in search of a new home.
Trapped in a room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe.

Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-endi
A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.
The highly-anticipated fifth installment of the Police Story franchise, starring Jackie Chan in a story of family ties, betrayal, and revenge.
Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers mo
A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.
After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.
After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.
A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?
With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.
A man learns that his unusual stomach pains are being caused by a demon living in his intestines.
Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.
A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.
After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.
When a beautiful young influencer survives a mysterious shark attack, she becomes a monstrous apex predator, hunting and feeding in sunny Venice beach, California.
A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.
A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.
Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.
A horror's author's stories come to life when read out loud.
A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

Dr. Rich Freeman (Tony Award winner Santino Fontana), an ambitious and well-liked psychology professor, pursues a sleep study with a focus on nightmares, dreams, and sleep paralysis -- the success of which would result in a lucrative grant. As the line between dreams and reality blur, a member of the study is murdered, and everything begins to unravel, leaving Rich fighting to make things right.
A modern-day witch uses spells and magic to get men to fall in love with her, in a tribute to 1960s Technicolor thrillers.
A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.
A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.
April 1862, in the Arizona territory. During the opening months of the Civil War, two enemy soldiers must cooperate in order to survive being stranded in the Sonoran Desert.
A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.
A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.
Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.
Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

t: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
d: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.
